title: The Real Reason We've Never Heard From Aliens

scenes.voiceover: The universe should be screaming with life. Instead, it is silent.
scenes.visualConcept: empty dark frame, one word slamming

scenes.voiceover: Billions of Earth-like planets. Thirteen billion years of time. And not one single signal.
One theory explains this perfectly. And you will wish it didn't.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: dark forest silhouette made of stars

scenes.voiceover: The universe is a dark forest. And every civilization is a hunter, moving silently between the trees.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: dark forest of stars, something moving

scenes.voiceover: You cannot know if a stranger is friendly. But you know they might destroy you. So the safest move is to stay quiet.
Which means anyone still broadcasting either knows something we don't. Or won't survive long.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: radio waves leaving earth into darkness

scenes.voiceover: And for one hundred years, Earth has been screaming into that forest. Radio. Television. Radar.
scenes.mainText: Earth has been SCREAMING for 100 years
scenes.visualConcept: expanding signal rings from a small dot
scenes.backgroundPrompt: earth broadcasting rings into dark space

scenes.voiceover: Maybe the silence isn't emptiness. Maybe it's everyone else hiding. Follow mindwired for more.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: quiet starfield, one dim light going out
